description: First comparison: thirteen level 1 approaches in one dimension, on four scenes under six conditions.

approach_files.shift-and-add:
name = "shift-and-add"
description = "Put every reading where it was taken and average. No sharpening. Shows what dense sampling alone gives."
hardware = ["sensor with its lens removed", "diffuse light", "scan stage", "position readout good to a few nanometres"]
positions = "known"

[reconstruction]
method = "shift_and_add"
approach_files.wiener:
name = "wiener"
description = "Shift and add, then undo the known blur wherever the signal is above the noise."
hardware = ["sensor with its lens removed", "diffuse light", "scan stage", "position readout good to a few nanometres"]
positions = "known"

[reconstruction]
method = "wiener"
noise_to_signal = 1e-3
approach_files.least-squares:
name = "least-squares"
description = "Find the surface whose predicted readings match the measured ones, with a preference for smoothness. Positions are given."
hardware = ["sensor with its lens removed", "diffuse light", "scan stage", "position readout good to a few nanometres"]
positions = "known"

[reconstruction]
method = "least_squares"
smoothness = 1e-2
approach_files.least-squares-light-smoothing:
name = "least-squares-light-smoothing"
description = "Least squares with ten times less smoothing, the same as the two-material fits use, so that those can be compared like for like. Positions are given."
hardware = ["sensor with its lens removed", "diffuse light", "scan stage", "position readout good to a few nanometres"]
positions = "known"

[reconstruction]
method = "least_squares"
smoothness = 1e-3
approach_files.least-squares-planned-positions:
name = "least-squares-planned-positions"
description = "The same fit, but trusting the planned constant speed with no position readout. The baseline for doing nothing about motion errors."
hardware = ["sensor with its lens removed", "diffuse light", "scan stage"]
positions = "unknown"

[reconstruction]
method = "least_squares"
smoothness = 1e-2
approach_files.position-solving:
name = "position-solving"
description = "Least squares with the position of every frame found from the readings themselves, each frame free."
hardware = ["sensor with its lens removed", "diffuse light", "scan stage"]
positions = "unknown"

[reconstruction]
method = "least_squares_positions"
smoothness = 1e-2
path_stiffness = 0.0
approach_files.smooth-path-position-solving:
name = "smooth-path-position-solving"
description = "Position solving with the rule that the sensor's path is smooth from frame to frame."
hardware = ["sensor with its lens removed", "diffuse light", "scan stage"]
positions = "unknown"

[reconstruction]
method = "least_squares_positions"
smoothness = 1e-2
path_stiffness = 10.0
approach_files.two-materials:
name = "two-materials"
description = "A fit that is told the two reflectances on the surface and pulls every point towards one of them. Positions are given."
hardware = ["sensor with its lens removed", "diffuse light", "scan stage", "position readout good to a few nanometres"]
positions = "known"

[knowledge]
materials = true

[reconstruction]
method = "two_materials"
smoothness = 1e-3
approach_files.two-materials-position-solving:
name = "two-materials-position-solving"
description = "Reconstruction by elimination, step-by-step form: smooth-path position solving, then the two-material fit. No position readout."
hardware = ["sensor with its lens removed", "diffuse light", "scan stage"]
positions = "unknown"

[knowledge]
materials = true

[reconstruction]
method = "two_materials_positions"
path_stiffness = 10.0
approach_files.narrow-opening:
name = "narrow-opening"
description = "Each pixel masked down to an opening a quarter of its width, which blurs less and collects a quarter of the light. Least squares, positions given."
hardware = ["sensor with its lens removed and a mask of 280 nm openings on the pixels", "diffuse light", "scan stage", "position readout good to a few nanometres"]
positions = "known"

[optics]
aperture_nm = 280.0

[reconstruction]
method = "least_squares"
smoothness = 1e-2
approach_files.fast-scan-short-pulse:
name = "fast-scan-short-pulse"
description = "Scan six times faster (2.37 pixels per frame) with the light flashed briefly for each frame. Least squares, positions given."
hardware = ["sensor with its lens removed", "pulsed light", "scan stage", "position readout good to a few nanometres"]
positions = "known"

[scan]
shift_px = 2.37
exposure_fraction = 0.0

[reconstruction]
method = "least_squares"
smoothness = 1e-2
approach_files.fast-scan-continuous-light:
name = "fast-scan-continuous-light"
description = "The fast scan with the light on all the time, so every reading is smeared over 2.37 pixels of movement. Least squares with the smear in its model."
hardware = ["sensor with its lens removed", "steady light", "scan stage", "position readout good to a few nanometres"]
positions = "known"

[scan]
shift_px = 2.37
exposure_fraction = 1.0

[reconstruction]
method = "least_squares"
smoothness = 1e-2
approach_files.fast-scan-coded-light:
name = "fast-scan-coded-light"
description = "The fast scan with the light switched on and off in a fixed irregular pattern within each frame, which keeps the smear reversible."
hardware = ["sensor with its lens removed", "light that can be switched within a frame", "scan stage", "position readout good to a few nanometres"]
positions = "known"

[scan]
shift_px = 2.37
exposure_fraction = 1.0
code = [1, 0, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 1]

[reconstruction]
method = "least_squares"
smoothness = 1e-2

comparison_file:
name = "level1-first"
description = "First comparison: thirteen level 1 approaches in one dimension, on four scenes under six conditions."
approaches = [
    "approaches/shift-and-add.toml",
    "approaches/wiener.toml",
    "approaches/least-squares.toml",
    "approaches/least-squares-light-smoothing.toml",
    "approaches/least-squares-planned-positions.toml",
    "approaches/position-solving.toml",
    "approaches/smooth-path-position-solving.toml",
    "approaches/two-materials.toml",
    "approaches/two-materials-position-solving.toml",
    "approaches/narrow-opening.toml",
    "approaches/fast-scan-short-pulse.toml",
    "approaches/fast-scan-continuous-light.toml",
    "approaches/fast-scan-coded-light.toml",
]
scenes = ["bars", "random_layout", "isolated_lines", "soft_ramps"]
seeds = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]

[[conditions]]
name = "ideal"
description = "Steady motion, full light, gap 300 nm, sharp pixel edges."

[[conditions]]
name = "shaky"
description = "Each frame misplaced at random by 0.3 pixel rms."
[conditions.scan]
jitter_px = 0.3

[[conditions]]
name = "wandering"
description = "The path wanders smoothly by 1 pixel rms, each wander lasting about 20 frames."
[conditions.scan]
wander_px = 1.0

[[conditions]]
name = "dim"
description = "One twenty-fifth of the light: 100 electrons at full brightness."
[conditions.noise]
full_e = 100.0

[[conditions]]
name = "wide gap"
description = "Gap of 1 µm instead of 300 nm."
[conditions.optics]
gap_nm = 1000.0

[[conditions]]
name = "soft pixels"
description = "Pixel edges soft over 150 nm instead of sharp."
[conditions.optics]
edge_sigma_nm = 150.0
